## Standards

<a id="DepthFirstSearch"></a>

### Depth-first search

`DepthFirstSearch` · `src/algorithms.ts:51`

Looking for a cycle: each vertex is first discovered (grey), then finished (black). Coming back to a grey vertex closes a cycle.

Source: Cormen, Leiserson, Rivest and Stein, Introduction to Algorithms, 3rd ed., § 22.3 Depth-first search

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `grey` | `grey` | Discovered, its search is not finished: coming back to it closes a cycle |
| `black` | `black` | Its search is finished, without a cycle |

- Maintained by: trame
- Serves: [A published value is cited, not copied](product.md#CitedNotCopied)

<a id="Mulberry32"></a>

### Mulberry32

`Mulberry32` · `src/algorithms.ts:17`

A 32-bit pseudo-random generator: fast, reproducible from a seed.

Source: Tommy Ettinger, Mulberry32 (2017, public domain) · `https://gist.github.com/tommyettinger/46a874533244883189143505d203312c`

| Constant | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `increment` | `1831565813` | Added to the state at each draw |
| `shift1` | `15` | First shift of the mix |
| `shift2` | `7` | Second shift of the mix |
| `shift3` | `14` | Last shift of the mix |
| `oddBit` | `1` | OR with 1: the first multiplier is odd |
| `odd` | `61` | Makes the second multiplier odd |
| `scale` | `4294967296` | 2³²: brings the draw between 0 and 1 |

- Maintained by: trame
- Serves: [A published value is cited, not copied](product.md#CitedNotCopied)
- Used by: [Seeded draws](#SeededDraws)

### Seeded draws

`SeededDraws` · `src/algorithms.ts:81` · status: **held**

Numbers drawn between 0 and 1, always the same from the same seed: Mulberry32 from a 32-bit state, the seed a number or a text hashed into one (multiplicative hashing); an integer drawn between two bounds, both included; an element of a list drawn by its weight. It touches nothing.
